note: 19 business credential NAMES across both programmes: 14 cannabis (683 rows) plus 5 hemp/THC-beverage (280 rows) the Oct snapshot omitted. Filtered on `credential`, NOT `credentialtype` - types CSM and CSW are shared with 'MANUFACTURER/WHOLESALER OF DRUGS, COSMETICS & MEDICAL DEVICES', which pulls in ~4,300 unrelated pharma licences.
